text: {"lessons":["I should check my holdings regularly enough to notice when a position or the whole account is deteriorating, rather than letting several months pass without review.","I should judge Stock C by its prospects and role in my portfolio, not by my average cost or the pain of realizing a loss.","A sharp decline can tempt me to act just to stop the discomfort; I should make each buy, sell, or hold decision deliberately and consider my overall risk and diversification."]}
